en_title: PUBG: Battlegrounds Gets K-Pop Girl Group Collab
opus_summary: 《PUBG: Battlegrounds》与韩国女团IVE联动，加入以歌曲《Love Dive》为主题的场景、角色造型和表情动作。联动现已登陆PC，11月12日登陆主机。两个PvE模式也将以更高难度回归，其中《HLB: Dawnbreakers of Rondo》于11月4日在PC上线。

paragraphs.en: PUBG: Battlegrounds is no stranger to unusual collaborations, but its latest might be one of its most unexpected yet. K-pop girl group IVE is bringing its hit song Love Dive to the battle royale shooter, complete with themed locations, character skins, choreography, and music videos — further proof there is no scenario that cannot be improved with a bit of K-pop.
paragraphs.cn: 《PUBG: Battlegrounds》对不同寻常的联动并不陌生，但最新的一次可能是迄今最出人意料的联动之一。K-pop女团IVE将把热门歌曲《Love Dive》带入这款大逃杀射击游戏，同时带来的还有主题地点、角色皮肤、舞蹈动作和音乐视频——这进一步证明，没有什么场景是加一点K-pop无法改善的。

paragraphs.en: The collaboration is live now on PC and arrives on console November 12, bringing three special IVE locations across Rondo, all inspired by the Love Dive music video, including the IVE Mansion. We're also getting all six members represented with character likenesses, outfits, accessories, and weapon and gear skins. Across six maps, Rondo, Erangel, Miramar, Taego, Deston, and Vikendi, there are special IVE Emote Stages where you can perform one of the special IVE emotes to see a music video (on PC) or some album artwork on console. You can also look forward to Cupid's Crossbow and Cupid Chicken Man "interactive elements" on starting islands.
paragraphs.cn: 此次联动现已在PC上推出，并将于11月12日登陆主机，为Rondo带来三处特别的IVE地点，其中包括IVE Mansion，所有地点的灵感均来自《Love Dive》音乐视频。六名成员也都将以角色形象、服装、配饰以及武器和装备皮肤的形式登场。在Rondo、Erangel、Miramar、Taego、Deston和Vikendi六张地图中，设有特别的IVE表情舞台，你可以在那里使用一种特别的IVE表情动作，在PC上观看音乐视频，或在主机上欣赏专辑美术图。你还可以期待起始岛上的Cupid's Crossbow和Cupid Chicken Man「互动元素」。

paragraphs.en: If you haven't yet discovered the total joy that is a good K-pop bop, the update also has something for players who prefer their PUBG experience with slightly less choreography and significantly more suffering. Two previous PvE modes are returning with increased difficulty.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你还没有发现一首好听的K-pop歌曲所带来的无穷乐趣，那么本次更新也为那些希望《PUBG》体验中舞蹈少一点、苦头多得多的玩家准备了内容。此前的两个PvE模式将以更高难度回归。

paragraphs.en: HLB: Dawnbreakers of Rondo will get more frequent enemies, additional fuel requirements, and weaker defensive objectives and runs from November 4 to 25 on PC and November 12 to December 3 on consoles.
paragraphs.cn: 《HLB: Dawnbreakers of Rondo》中的敌人出现得将更加频繁，燃料需求将增加，防御目标也将更加脆弱。该模式在PC上的开放时间为11月4日至25日，主机上的开放时间为11月12日至12月3日。

paragraphs.en: Returning roguelite mode Xeno Point: Hell trades the three OG difficulty levels for a single Hell difficulty and adds a tougher fourth sector. That mode runs from November 18 to December 2 on PC and November 26 to December 10 on console.
paragraphs.cn: 回归的轻度Roguelike模式《Xeno Point: Hell》将原有的三个难度等级替换为单一的Hell难度，并加入难度更高的第四区域。该模式在PC上的开放时间为11月18日至12月2日，主机上的开放时间为11月26日至12月10日。

paragraphs.en: Whether you're dropping into Rondo for the chicken dinners or the choreography, PUBG's latest update certainly offers something a little different. I'm starting a petition for a Stray Kids collaboration immediately.
paragraphs.cn: 无论你跳伞进入Rondo是为了吃鸡还是跳舞，《PUBG》的最新更新都确实带来了一些不太一样的内容。我这就发起请愿，要求与Stray Kids联动。
